response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), f AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS frac FROM g), a AS (SELECT ID, cnt, frac, AVG(frac) OVER () AS avg_frac FROM f) SELECT ID, cnt AS num_examinations, frac AS fraction, frac - avg_frac AS excess_over_average FROM a WHERE frac > avg_frac ORDER BY excess_over_average DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The total is the number of examinations with a non-null ID (since those without an ID are excluded), and the average fraction is the unweighted mean of the per-patient fractions across all groups (computed before filtering to above-average groups).
Fractions are expressed as proportions between 0 and 1, not percentages.
